# CheckYourself

> Local-first production-readiness audit for AI-built apps: read-only checks, 0–100 score, stable rule IDs, guided fixes.

## Getting Started

- [README.md](README.md) — overview, quick start, what it checks, CLI/MCP setup, FAQ
- [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md) — entry point for AI assistants starting a new audit session
- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md) — project context file that orients the AI assistant to the audit workspace
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent behavioral rules, roast-lite voice, safety model, and approval gates

## Core Reference

- [rules.md](rules.md) — review, safety, evidence, and workflow rules for the diagnostic
- [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md) — canonical detector-rule registry and CLI command reference (scan, diagnostic, diff, score, coverage, backlog, next)
- [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) — MCP server setup, tool list, scan-root confinement, expected agent flow
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — version history including the v1.7.0 diff command and stable rule IDs

## Schemas

The `schemas/` directory contains JSON schema contracts for every structured output:

- [schemas/scan.schema.json](schemas/scan.schema.json) — findings from a scan run
- [schemas/diff.schema.json](schemas/diff.schema.json) — diff output (added/resolved/regressed findings)
- [schemas/score-result.schema.json](schemas/score-result.schema.json) — scored report with severity caps
- [schemas/checkyourself-report.schema.json](schemas/checkyourself-report.schema.json) — full diagnostic report
- [schemas/coverage.schema.json](schemas/coverage.schema.json) — coverage evidence structure
- [schemas/backlog.schema.json](schemas/backlog.schema.json) — ranked fix backlog
- [schemas/next-batch.schema.json](schemas/next-batch.schema.json) — next highest-severity batch; safety analysis remains with the diagnostic and reviewer

## Diagnostic Reference

- [02_RUN_DIAGNOSTIC/coverage-matrix.md](02_RUN_DIAGNOSTIC/coverage-matrix.md) — coverage surface matrix used during the diagnostic pass

## Advanced Hardening

- [90_ADVANCED/README.md](90_ADVANCED/README.md) — deep-dive hardening library; agents load sections on demand when a finding needs deeper guidance

## Agent Skill

- [skills/checkyourself/SKILL.md](skills/checkyourself/SKILL.md) — installable skill for Claude Code and Codex skill aggregators
